raw_text:
description: Agent processing may improve vault quality while atrophying human knowledge-work skills.
topics: ["[[agent-cognition]]"]
source: TFT research corpus (00_inbox/heinrich/)

The source warns: "To fully automate [metadata creation] is to outsource the very cognitive process that PKM seeks to enhance." At scale, agent extraction, connection-finding, and synthesis may erode human skill at structuring ideas, recognizing connections, and judging importance.

Three mechanisms:
- **Collector's Fallacy inversion:** Agents empty the inbox and organize the vault, hiding shallow human understanding behind apparently productive output.
- **Generation Effect bypass:** Generating ideas in one's own words supports memory; agent-generated connections improve the vault without necessarily engaging human cognition. Approval may not provide enough active transformation.
- **Extended Mind decoupling:** Offloading extends cognition only through an active mind–tool loop. Without deep engagement, the vault becomes adjacent to the human mind rather than part of it.

AI-native “dump everything, we organize it” tools normalize full delegation. Ars contexta's creator-to-curator shift retains human direction and approval, but whether judgment alone preserves the skills needed to do the work remains unresolved.

Core question: Is approving agent work sufficient cognitive engagement to maintain the skills that would be needed to do the work yourself? This differs from testing memory of specific content: the concern is long-term skill atrophy. A warning sign is being unable to imagine working without the agent. Possible mitigations include periodic manual processing and focused approval of smaller tend/prune/fertilize decisions rather than blanket approval.

Connections: [[cognitive offloading is the architectural foundation for vault design]] identifies the foundation and its failure mode; [[the generation effect requires active transformation not just storage]] and [[skills encode methodology so manual execution bypasses quality gates]] explain the mechanism. [[does agent processing recover what fast capture loses]] concerns content encoding instead. [[LLM attention degrades as context fills]] parallels this invisible degradation; [[fresh context per task preserves quality better than chaining phases]] suggests deliberate non-delegation as a parallel mitigation. [[gardening cycle implements tend prune fertilize operations]] may make rubber-stamping harder. [[maintenance targeting should prioritize mechanism and theory notes]] favors links to delegation mechanisms over MOC neighbors. [[PKM failure follows a predictable cycle]], [[productivity porn risk in meta-system building]], and [[verbatim risk applies to agents too]] describe related but distinct risks. [[vibe notetaking is the emerging industry consensus for AI-native self-organization]] amplifies delegation; [[you operate a system that takes notes]] frames the creator-to-curator shift.
